name: Pumble
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Pumble, run straightforward team channels, direct messages, threads, and file sharing. The hard boundary is cross-platform apps, push, guest access, admin controls, and hosted reliability, plus network, moderation, and communication infrastructure.
